title: Plan option for a lancedb-enabled quipu install
description: Gap G2 from docs/design/txtai-gap-analysis.md (txtai comparison). Quipu release binaries deliberately exclude the lancedb feature, so ANN + BM25 FTS are unreachable from a caboodle-installed store and vector.backend=lancedb refuses at startup. Offer the choice as a reviewed plan line: a quipu install flavor that builds from the pinned source revision with --features lancedb (source-install adapter already exists), with version read-back and the functional round-trip proving the flavor actually compiled in (GET /version per-feature map). Acceptance: plan field defaults to the release flavor; lancedb flavor drives a source install with the feature; verify fails if /version lacks the feature; docs updated.
close_reason: Landed in c223e42: plan-level quipu_flavor (default release, omitted when default), lancedb flavor drives the same reviewed cargo-install pin with --features full,lancedb, and verify proves the flavor via the server GET /version per-feature compile map (red on absent feature or absent map; exit codes never accepted). Unit + CLI tests; book updated (profiles.md, installing.md). check-updates cannot see flavor drift (documented); verify is the catch point.

title: No macOS release binaries for stack tools
description: caboodle apply on aarch64-apple-darwin fails: 'Quipu has no checksummed CABOODLE release for aarch64-macos'. Stack tools ship Linux-only artifacts, so an agent onboarding on a Mac cannot install the stack. How to apply: publish mac artifacts for quipu/camayoc/bobbin/yupana, or add a source-build fallback in apply.

title: Provision checksum-pinned embedding model artifacts with an embed proof
description: Gap G6 from docs/design/txtai-gap-analysis.md (txtai comparison). txtai auto-downloads models; quipu deliberately bundles none (onnx feature ships the runtime only) and camayoc's competency scorer sits weights-less after a CDN 403. Caboodle owns the first hour, so provisioning belongs here: a plan line naming model artifacts (model.onnx, tokenizer.json, config) each with URL + sha256, fetched to a reviewed location, refused on checksum mismatch, recorded in state like every install step. Verification proves an embed-and-search round-trip with a negative control instead of trusting file presence. Acceptance: plan schema + fetch/verify with checksum refusal; state records provisioned models; round-trip proof wired into verify when quipu has onnx configured; docs updated.
close_reason: Landed in 6f38b17: [embedding_model] plan section (destination + artifacts pinned by https url + sha256), apply fetches with hash-before-name, deletes and refuses mismatches nonzero on a named step, idempotent no-op recorded as current, state.json models entries like other steps. Verify re-hashes artifacts on disk and fails on drift/absence; the embed round-trip is NOT wired (no reviewed quipu embeddings contract to drive) and the book states that split plainly. Tests are network-free (temp-file fixtures, fake curl, FIPS 180-2 hash anchor).

title: init requires --guided; plan requires an intent file
description: caboodle init errors without --guided, and caboodle plan errors without caboodle-intent.toml which only the guided interview produces. The premise is that Claude Code / Codex drive the install unattended, but there is no non-interactive path. How to apply: allow init/plan from flags or a documented default intent so an agent can pipe answers or skip the interview.
